finding: Five hardcoded hub lists must change for admission: HUB_CHILD, DEFAULT_ON_HUBS, guard HUBS, sync HUBS, serving-closure manifest hubs[]. None derived; omission silently disables automation.

mint is inert (legacy/shadowOnly, gen 1, no overwrite); refresh increments generation and preserves authority; freshness must use the hub's shadow-child snapshot; the compiled flip has no CLI and is manual.

Three enforcement moments: pre-commit auto re-mint (SKILL.md trigger, staged+unstaged refusal, authored-copy sync), guard (stale-manifest + authored-drift + expiring exemptions), request-time status probe (manifestFreshness causeCodes).

compiled-route-sync traces require/file reads across every hub and copies the touched closure; serving-closure.manifest.json (48 files) is the promoted inventory; a new hub must join the traced path and the sync HUBS list.
